itens.trecho: Uma paródia aos filmes de terror? Este filme é daqueles que não sabemos se devemos levar a sério. Tudo acontece numa cidade pequena do litoral da Califórnia, onde a jovem Sidney Prescott é perseguida por um misterioso assassino psicopata, mascarado com roupas pretas e uma máscara que parece saída de uma pintura de Edvard Munch.

Now let's be honest. Who didn't guess right from the outset what was going on in the sleepy Californian town of "Woodsboro"? Perhaps I'd just watched too many editions of "Scooby Do" as a child to be left in the dark for very long, but it's really the execution of this darkly comedic horror that made it an enjoyable watch.

Scream delivered a breath of fresh air into the slasher franchise and holds up rather well nearly 30 years later. The plot of this film follows a cookie-cutter structure that models nearly all of the great slasher franchises of the late 1970s and early 1980s, but that is entirely the point.
